selected_branch_activation_to_prove: A stop or sudden speed decrease occurs with a vehicle immediately to the rear and without an appropriate prior signal to its driver.
original_source_measurements_required: Measure deceleration onset, immediately trailing vehicle, signal visibility/onset, and stop-versus-sudden-slow alternatives.
reviewed_selected_branch: Sudden decrease in speed with a vehicle immediately to the rear
temporal_signal_caveat: The frozen clause does not define a numerical lead time or declare that a brake lamp illuminated only by the same deceleration is prior warning. Brake and hand signals require original source timing and independent appropriateness review.
